rules.description: Estate value exceeds the nil-rate band threshold
rules.reason_if_failed: No Inheritance Tax is due. You may still need to complete a simpler form (IHT205) to obtain probate.

rules.description: Death has occurred and applicant is the executor or administrator
rules.reason_if_failed: IHT400 must be completed by the executor named in the will or the administrator appointed by the court

rules.description: Tax must be paid within 6 months of death (before probate granted)
rules.reason_if_failed: Payment is overdue. Interest will be charged from 6 months after death. You should complete the return urgently.

rules.description: Estate includes UK assets subject to Inheritance Tax
rules.reason_if_failed: If the deceased was domiciled abroad with no UK assets, UK Inheritance Tax may not apply

explanation_template: Inheritance Tax (IHT400) eligibility: {outcome}. Estate value: £{estate_gross_value}. Threshold: £{applicable_threshold}.

edge_cases.description: Estate leaves 10% or more to charity and may qualify for reduced 36% rate
edge_cases.action: Apply reduced rate of 36% instead of 40%. Calculate net value and ensure qualifying charitable gifts are properly documented.

edge_cases.description: Deceased made substantial gifts in the 7 years before death
edge_cases.action: Assess each gift for taper relief. Gifts in years 3-7 before death may qualify for reduced rates. Recipients may be liable for tax on gifts exceeding £325,000 threshold.

edge_cases.description: Home left to direct descendants (children/grandchildren) and estate under £2m
edge_cases.action: Additional £175,000 threshold may apply (total £500,000). Verify relationship of beneficiaries and property ownership.

edge_cases.description: Estate includes business or agricultural assets
edge_cases.action: Business Relief or Agricultural Relief may apply (50-100% reduction). Requires specialist valuation. Route to Inheritance Tax helpline.
Trust taxation is complex and requires specialist advice. Route to HMRC Trust team or recommend professional advisor.

edge_cases.description: Deceased was domiciled outside UK or lived abroad for 10+ of last 20 years
edge_cases.action: Only UK assets are taxable. Excluded assets (foreign currency accounts, overseas pensions) do not attract UK IHT. Check double-taxation treaties.

edge_cases.description: Deceased gave away assets but continued to benefit from them
edge_cases.action: Gift with reservation counts towards estate value regardless of when given. Assess whether donor paid market rent or had genuine arms-length arrangement.

edge_cases.description: Assets passing to UK-resident spouse or civil partner
edge_cases.action: No Inheritance Tax on spouse/civil partner inheritance. Unused nil-rate band transfers to surviving partner. Verify UK residency status.
